en.label: Mode of delivery for our mobility students abroad:
en.content: Internships can be carried out within the framework of foreign mobility (Erasmus+, CEEPUS, bilateral agreements, etc.) and can be recognized as an internship. Requirements: (1) completed e-form (on the website); (2) Learning Agreement of Traineeship; (3) confirmation of completion of the internship - "Certificate of internship" Completion of a foreign professional trip organized by a university/faculty, with a minimum stay of 1 month, can be recognized as an internship. Requirements: (1) copy of the internship/trip contract submitted before the start of the internship; (2) final report on the completion of the internship/trip.
